## H0056 — historical audit

**Scope.** This is a student trace, not a scene task. Only chunk 2 of 2 is visible. The likely goal was an Obsidian Linter rule that generates a configurable table of contents between markers; the original task instruction is not visible. Citations below refer to source **H0056**, original file `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/hint-codex-experiments/runs/codex_parallel_05/lanes/codex_parallel_05_lane4/codex_parallel_05_lane4_H_r1/infer_logs/obsidian-linter-auto-table-of-contents/turn_1/trajs.json`.

| Area | Observed evidence |
|---|---|
| Changes | The final diff shows a new registered `auto-toc.ts` rule and English locale entries. The rule scans headings outside the TOC region, constructs anchors, handles duplicate anchors, and offers list, level, title, formatting, explicit-ID and exclusion options. These are code operations, not demonstrated behavior. [main_agent:event:70, chars 0–19144] |
| Autonomous exploration | After type errors, the student searched existing numeric-option conventions and changed three fields to `Number`. It later changed how following blank lines are preserved. [events 57–60, chars 0–700, 0–1256, 0–773, 0–8041; events 67–68, chars 0–1100, 0–8880] |
| Validation | Build failed on unresolved `expect` and `micromark-extension-frontmatter`; offline installation failed for uncached `zwitch`. Type-checking also reported three errors in the new rule alongside other errors. The subsequent numeric-field edit was not followed by a visible type-check, so its effectiveness is unverified. [events 50, 52, 54, 60, chars 0–4247, 0–20425, 0–855, 0–8041] |
| Tests and delivery | One Jest invocation found no tests because its path was wrong; a corrected invocation segfaulted. The student reviewed the diff and committed two files as `25a6ca9`. No passing local behavioral test is visible. [events 62, 64, 66, 70, 72, chars 0–1361, 0–7613, 0–591, 0–19144, 0–733] |
| Formal outcome | Supplied inventory metadata reports **partial correctness, formally not solved**: 37/41 fail-to-pass and 1060/1131 pass-to-pass. The underlying evaluation details and failing cases are not visible here. The patch was nonempty; local verification also suffered technical interruptions. |
| Teacher input | Hint and review files are listed as available in inventory metadata, but this visible chunk contains no delivered teacher text or evidence of its adoption. Availability is not receipt; the after-round review cannot be input to this round. |

**Lessons and uncertainty.** Transferably, distinguish a source edit and commit from validated behavior, and rerun checks after a fix. Task-specifically, marker handling, heading parsing, anchors and whitespace remain candidates for targeted investigation, but the visible record does not identify which caused the formal failures. Earlier exploration, actual teacher receipt, and the full specification remain unknown because the other chunk is not visible.
